newsitem.title: INDIA: Eleven killed in bus accident in western India.
newsitem.headline: Eleven killed in bus accident in western India.

text.p: At least eleven people were killed and five injured on Wednesday when a mini-bus collided with a truck in the western Indian state of Gujarat, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said.
The incident occurred on a highway some 42 km (26 miles) southwest of the state capital Ahmedabad when the mini-bus carrying the passangers to a peasant rally ran into the truck, the PTI said.
The injured were admitted to a nearby hospital, the PTI said. It gave no more details.
